summary:
## Overview
A fixture brief for the browser suite: two change groups over three files, with a risk surface, a diff per chunk, and a second revision to compare against.

## What it does
- **Accessibility & brand:** lifts the faint text token to a passing contrast ratio and adds a skip-to-content link.
- **Keyboard navigation:** J/K step through chunks; `?` opens the shortcuts modal.

changeGroups.title: Add J/K/Z/? keyboard navigation and CSS-only focus mode to the brief screen
changeGroups.summary: Introduces a `useKeyboardShortcuts` hook (with a pure, unit-tested `resolveShortcut` decision function) wiring J/K chunk stepping, Z focus mode, ? shortcuts modal, and Esc layering into BriefPage; adds a CSS-only focus mode (`data-zen`) that isolates the active group/chunk and renders a collapsible FocusGroupRail in StoryView, plus a new ShortcutsModal and supporting styles. Characterization and test-setup stubs back the new behavior.

changeGroups.title: Front-door accessibility and brand metadata fixes
changeGroups.summary: Fixes WCAG AA gaps: lifts `--faint` contrast, adds a skip-to-content link and shared `#main-content` landmark, promotes the PR title to `<h1>`, makes the toast an aria-live status region, and adds an SVG favicon with description/OG/twitter meta.

pr.title: feat: front-door accessibility and keyboard navigation
